name: Governed release of the dun package to PyPI

assurance.declaration: descriptive local release plan, not an issued grant or execution receipt
assurance.runtime_enforcement: none; steps are executed by the operator or coding agent

execution_model: Descriptive finite DAG. Publication happens only after the independent Validator merged the exact release head.
preconditions: Release ticket merged to main by the independent Validator App
VERSION, pyproject.toml and CHANGELOG.md declare the same new version
PyPI credentials available to the operator for the dun project

steps.operation: git fetch origin main && git rev-parse origin/main
steps.rule: Read back the Validator review and merge actor for the exact release head.
Build sdist and wheel from the merged commit only.

steps.operation: install the wheel in a fresh virtualenv, run pytest, and import every dun module
steps.rule: Abort on any import or test failure.

steps.operation: git tag -a v<VERSION> <merged-sha> && git push origin v<VERSION>
steps.rule: Annotated tag on the merged commit.
Upload the exact artifacts that passed the smoke test; never reuse a version.
Confirm file hashes on PyPI match the built artifacts.
